description.text: Note:Students applying for degree education need to pass HSK (Chinese Proficiency Examination). If they do not have HSK certificate, they have to pass HSK before entering professional study. According to the teaching plan, the first year after admission is for strengthening students’ Chinese language proficiency. Only after they have obtained HSK Level 4 (or above) Certificate, can they get graduated.

duration.text: The Clinical Laboratory Diagnostics at Hainan Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Undergraduate school transcript 5. Two Recommendation letters From Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should hold bachelor’s degree or the same educational level; 2. Recommend by two or more associate professors/professor; 3. Younger than 45 years old; 4. Healthy and with a good command of English language. Note: Students need to pass HSK level 4 before they graduate.
